name: MikroTik Telegram Bot
description: Enterprise-grade Telegram Bot system for managing MikroTik RouterOS devices, Hotspot users, User Manager, Backups, and Health Monitoring.

Presentation Layer.description: Telegram Handlers, Keyboards, and UI formatting logic.

Application Layer.description: Command/Callback routing, ConversationHandler states, and application lifecycle.

Service Layer.description: Pure Python domain services for Hotspot, User Manager, Backups, Health Watchdog, Reports, and PDF generation.

Infrastructure & Integration Layer.description: MikroTik RouterOS API wrappers, Connection Pooling, File Server HTTP Listener, and FTP Transport.

Repository & Database Layer.description: SQLite ORM/CRUD Repositories, Schema migrations via Alembic, and Shared State synchronization.

Utilities & Cross-Cutting.description: Decorators (@admin_only, @require_role), Cryptography (Fernet), Error Sanitization, Logging with Request ID, Chat Cleaner, and Validators.
